visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. Built from components/site/v3. Same place-type class as /cities/[slug]/types/[type].
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin community type filters. A dedicated community+type page with leftover/segment stats, the parent community atlas, and photographed listings of that type, instead of a search-results URL. Unique title, canonical, ItemList when listings exist. Breadcrumb is City then type, no Home.
note: Same composition as /cities/[slug]/types/[type], from that route's _v3 components. H1 `{Type} in {Place}` is the only display line; the Atlas wears an eyebrow under it; one section-0 claim sentence with its source line, single-sourced on listing_tile_mv. The page still reads the recorded boundary itself because the LIST depends on its pins (Sunriver: 52 listings by polygon, 0 by subdivision name, measured 2026-09-09); the Atlas re-reads the resort outline on its own streamed budget so one miss is not both. Communities with no trusted polygon and no resort GeoJSON (sunriver, brasada-ranch) render the standin's unavailable state instead of nothing. Unknown type notFound().

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts place-type-community — grok-4.6 via grok CLI, three scorings of live first-viewport shots at /communities/tetherow/types/single-family; separate from the grok-4.5 builder. SITE-78 yielded code edits on lib/place/place-type-page.ts and cities/_v3 to SITE-89 (place-type holder); live fold already had H1 + claim count/band + Atlas.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, https://ryan-realty.com/communities/tetherow/types/single-family (live; claim+Atlas already shipped)

tasteReview.beats: Tetherow.com — we win on live MLS count, asking-price band, and 90-day sales density with a named Oregon Data Share timestamp; we lose on photography and place character, and Zillow community pages beat this fold on photographed listings.

defects.finding: Sales-density cells and listing dots are the same gray-on-cream, so the 17 for-sale marks and the 90-day volume story do not separate at a glance on 1440 or 375.
The $1,350,000–$4,250,000 band lives only in the claim sentence; the slider sits at any price with no distribution, so scrubbing is chrome instead of the data.

defects.section: atlas activity list (Just listed / Went pending / Sold)
defects.finding: Three price bullets with no photo, bar, or mark; the catalog photographed-listing rail never appears in the first viewport, so a house is never visible.
At 375 the legend, price scrubber, zoom, See the 17, and Talk to a broker are all gone, so contact and the listing path are not reachable from what is visible.
A House toggle on a single-family type page is leftover filter chrome that adds a row of admin UI without revealing more data.
The map label restates single-family as a second display line with no fact after the H1 already named the type.

priorMark.note: Taste-table instrument mark SITE-78 must beat. Prior committed receipt (2026-09-09, claude-sonnet-5, score 70, rubric v1-2026-09-08) differs on evaluatorModel, rubricVersion, and shotsHash from this grok-4.6 / v1-2026-09-10 pass.
